caption: The drawing features a single object, a shell, centered on a small square piece of paper that is mounted on a larger, light beige rectangular background. The shell is outlined in fine, precise black lines and is depicted with swirling, ridged patterns that curl from its left to right, giving it a textured appearance. The inner structure of the shell is suggested by closely spaced contour lines and curves that radiate from the upper right corner, mimicking the natural grooves and whorls found on shells. The shell is rendered in a minimalist style without any color or shading, utilizing only the thin black lines on an uncolored light brown or tan background. There are no additional objects or decorative details in the composition, and the focus remains entirely on the shell, which occupies most of the square central area. The drawing is framed by the surrounding blank space of the mounting paper.
title: Turban
